newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dassault Electronique leads rare Paris gainers.
newsitem.headline: Dassault Electronique leads rare Paris gainers.

text.p: Shares in Dassault Electronique were the top gainers among few risers on a bearish Paris Bourse on Monday.
Dassault, which is also listed in New York, gained 1.48 percent at 550 francs and continued a recovery from a sharp slide to 509 francs on June 24 from 743 francs on March 5.
Textile groups Chargeurs, up 1.03 percent at 344.50, and Damart, up 0.11 percent at 4,625, also advanced as rumours about a pending bid for DMC petered out.
Euro Disney was 1.16 percent higher at 8.70 after a prologed slide. The share hit an all-time closing low of 8.45 francs on July 22 after a long decline from 14.70 in June 1996.
Another gainer was Klepierre, up 0.39 percent at 763, after AXA-UAP had been selling the share recently and reduced its stake to below five percent.
Primagaz, a share which suffered recently from dollar strength, up 0.44 percent at 497.90 francs, was helped by the dollar's relative weakness.
